verdict.rationale: Qdrant is a vector search engine and database. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations belongs to workflow and automation products, and nothing in the evidence shows Qdrant ships an automation or workflow feature. Collection snapshots are point-in-time data and configuration archives, not versioning or review of automations, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
